_comment: Surfaces that are NOT feature-gated and must therefore render for any tenant,
whatever its feature flags say — the home tabs every community gets and the
always-present admin tabs. scripts/ui_flag_sweep.sh drives this list with the
flags forced off; anything here that breaks is an ungated surface reaching into
the Challonge/Brackets/Triforce/Volunteer admin tabs) belong in a normal
/ui-validation run, not here: with the flag off they are *supposed* to vanish.
Tabs are addressed by URL section (/home/<slug>, /admin/<slug>, per
theme.base.tab_slug) rather than by clicking a tab label: the section route
makes that tab the page's default, so its content is built during the initial
render and a failure shows up without depending on a click landing.
